features.name: Provider Model Management

features.evidence: 2026-07-12: Remote API-key and Subscription base URLs are editable with server-side URL/type validation. Focused unit/database E2E, pnpm run verify (62 files/317 tests), and all 9 feature regressions pass.

features.name: Gateway Protocol Execution
features.description: Gateway executes Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and Embeddings with provider header/body transparency, streaming safety, and metadata-only logs.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/gateway-request-hygiene.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-error-fidelity.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-metadata-only-logging.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/v1-gateway-routing.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-request-hygiene.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-error-fidelity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-metadata-only-logging.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-11: All four public protocols, streaming/error fidelity, request-metadata-only logs, and provider smoke E2E pass. Responses requires canonical list input and performs no Codex parameter rewriting or SSE-to-JSON bridging. features.name: Agent Access And Limits
features.description: Agent API keys, required Virtual Model grants, atomic creation, explicit Limits enablement, reversible Agent enable/disable, RPM, TPM, token, budget, and concurrency limits are enforced without non-core Agent modes or logging switches.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/agent-management-contract.unit.test.ts tests/features/gateway-settlement-integrity.unit.test.ts tests/features/refactor-agent-limit-domain-types.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/agent-management-contract.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/gateway-settlement-integrity.e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/v1-console.e2e.spec.ts
features.evidence: 2026-07-12: Agent creation atomically commits the API key, required Virtual Model grants, default model, Limits switch, and rules. Gateway skips Limits access while the switch is off, preserved rules resume when re-enabled, and disabling/re-enabling restores the same key without deleting configuration or history. Focused verification passes 13 unit and 7 database/real-process E2E checks; pnpm run verify passes 62 files/327 tests and all 9 feature regressions pass.
